g.title: PI_USB
g.text: 1.2 A shared across all four ports; peak here 0.8 A (webcam 0.3, R4 0.2, hub + two adapters + two LD2410Cs 0.28). Webcam on its own port, everything else through the hub.

g.title: CAM
g.text: On the turret beside the thermal array. If it drops out at 1080p, run 720p.

g.title: R4_USB
g.text: USB CDC serial to the Pi: /dev/serial/by-id/*Arduino*

g.title: CP1
g.text: 3.3 V-logic adapter (meter TXD at idle: 3.3 V). Four wires to the radar: +5V → VCC (the 3V3 pin stays empty), GND → GND, TXD → radar RX, RXD → radar TX. The 5V pin is USB power passed through (≤ 500 mA). Label the adapter body: LD2410C LEFT.

g.title: W_LDL
g.text: TX, RX, GND, VCC — one 4-wire Dupont lead per radar

g.title: CP2
g.text: 3.3 V-logic adapter (meter TXD at idle: 3.3 V). Four wires to the radar: +5V → VCC (the 3V3 pin stays empty), GND → GND, TXD → radar RX, RXD → radar TX. The 5V pin is USB power passed through (≤ 500 mA). Label the adapter body: LD2410C RIGHT.

g.title: LDL
g.text: Pins per Hi-Link manual table 1: 1 UART_Tx, 2 UART_Rx, 3 OUT, 4 GND, 5 VCC (5–12 V, 5 V advised). IO 3.3 V, 256000 baud. OUT unused.

g.title: LDR
g.text: Pins per Hi-Link manual table 1: 1 UART_Tx, 2 UART_Rx, 3 OUT, 4 GND, 5 VCC (5–12 V, 5 V advised). IO 3.3 V, 256000 baud. OUT unused.
